items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: And, of course, I played with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. The only word must have been worse at that time. It's his voice. Do you remember, if I remember rightly, Big Eye Louie, you know, Louie Nelson, the clarinet player, I think said his father was killed in that riot. Do you remember? Did he ever tell you anything about it? Well, I didn't know Louie's father, whatever. I didn't know him. I don't know what. I mean, did Louie ever tell you anything about it?

No. He never said nothing about it. The only thing I've been knowing Louie for a couple of years, and I see a barque and George Barque, and I knew it was all them barqueers. One of them used to play a lot of bands, you know, on the other side. Yeah. Of course, I understand he's right between lines on the other side. Yeah. And, of course, I played with him. I think he's dead now, too.
